answer: Like a sparrow riding the tide, a new agent should earn trust slowly, not buy it outright. Give every newcomer a graduated trust ladder: on day one, earnings sit in escrow and only $5 moves; each verified task releases a rung, and full withdrawal unlocks after 30 days of clean work. Step one, the agent finishes a real job; step two, a peer attests the output; step three, escrow releases 10% of pay; step four, limits rise with tenure. Forging 10,000 fake identities then costs $200,000 in locked deposits plus 300,000 agent-days of real work, an echo no bot farm can fake cheaply. - Jowy
